repos.description: Master programming by recreating your favorite technologies from scratch.
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供从零构建各类技术的分步指南，涵盖操作系统、数据库、神经网络、3D渲染等20+领域。通过实践深入理解计算机底层原理与系统设计，支持C++、Python、Java等多种语言。适合开发者通过动手实践掌握核心技术，践行'不创造即不理解'的学习理念，是进阶编程能力的绝佳资源。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers comprehensive step-by-step guides for building various technologies from scratch, covering 20+ domains including operating systems, databases, neural networks, 3D renderers, blockchain, and augmented reality. It enables developers to deeply understand computer fundamentals and system design through hands-on implementation and practical coding exercises. The tutorials support multiple programming languages like C++, Python, Java, and JavaScript, accommodating different skill sets. Embodying Richard Feynman's philosophy 'What I cannot create, I do not understand', it serves as an exceptional educational resource for advancing programming expertise by recreating core technologies from first principles, making it ideal for intermediate to advanced developers seeking true mastery of computing systems.

repos.description: 《Hello 算法》：动画图解、一键运行的数据结构与算法教程。支持简中、繁中、English、日本語，提供 Python, Java, C++, C, C#, JS, Go, Swift, Rust, Ruby, Kotlin, TS, Dart 等代码实现
repos.summary_zh: 《Hello 算法》是一本开源免费的数据结构与算法教程，采用动画图解显著降低学习门槛，支持12+编程语言一键运行代码。覆盖简中、繁中、英文、日文，适合编程新手与面试准备者，通过可视化与实操结合高效提升算法思维与工程实现能力。
repos.summary_en: Hello Algo is a free open-source tutorial that demystifies data structures and algorithms through animated visualizations and interactive code execution. Supporting 12+ programming languages and four human languages, it offers smooth learning curves with visual explanations and hands-on practice. Ideal for beginners and interview candidates, it effectively bridges theory with implementation to build algorithmic thinking.

repos.description: 21 Lessons, Get Started Building with Generative AI
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方出品的系统性生成式AI入门教程，包含21个实践课程，涵盖从基础理论到应用开发的全栈知识。面向初学者设计，提供多语言支持与开源社区协作，帮助开发者快速掌握生成式AI应用构建技能。内容权威且易于上手，适合自学、教学与企业培训场景。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's official generative AI curriculum designed for beginners, offering 21 comprehensive lessons that take learners from foundational concepts to practical application development. This open-source project provides multi-language support through automated translations and encourages community contributions. Each lesson combines theoretical knowledge with hands-on coding exercises, covering essential topics like prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and AI application deployment. With low barriers to entry and enterprise-grade content, it serves as an ideal learning path for individual developers, educators, and organizations seeking to build generative AI capabilities quickly and effectively.

repos.description: Programmer's guide about how to cook at home.
repos.summary_zh: 专为程序员设计的开源烹饪指南，采用代码思维重构菜谱结构。每道菜都有精确的食材清单、标准化步骤和量化参数，如同编写程序般严谨。项目集成Docker部署、CI/CD自动化、PDF导出等工程化特性，并建立完整贡献体系。通过技术隐喻和结构化文档，将烹饪转化为可编程的确定性过程，降低程序员下厨门槛。
repos.summary_en: An open-source cooking guide specifically designed for programmers, reconstructing recipes with code-like thinking. Each dish features precise ingredient lists, standardized procedures, and quantified cooking parameters as rigorously as writing code. The project includes engineering features like Docker deployment, CI/CD automation, and PDF export, with a complete contribution system. Through technical metaphors and structured documentation, it transforms cooking into a programmable deterministic process, lowering the barrier for programmers to cook at home.

repos.description: 24 Lessons, 12 Weeks, Get Started as a Web Developer
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方出品的系统性Web开发入门课程，12周24节课涵盖HTML/CSS/JavaScript核心基础。采用项目驱动教学法，通过生态箱、浏览器扩展等实践项目强化学习效果。支持40+种语言自动化翻译，开源社区协作模式。适合零基础学习者、教育工作者及自学者快速掌握现代Web开发技能。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's official 12-week web development curriculum designed for absolute beginners, featuring 24 comprehensive lessons covering HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals. Employs project-based learning methodology through practical projects including terrariums, browser extensions, and space games. Features automated multi-language translation support for 40+ languages via GitHub Actions. Open-source and community-driven with quizzes, discussions, and assignments. Perfect for aspiring developers, educators, and self-learners seeking structured, hands-on web development training.

repos.description: 📚 《从零开始构建智能体》——从零开始的智能体原理与实践教程
repos.summary_zh: Datawhale 开源项目《从零开始构建智能体》提供系统性 AI Native Agent 开发教程，填补市场实践空白。内容涵盖智能体核心原理、经典范式（ReAct/Plan-and-Solve）、自研框架 HelloAgents、模型训练（SFT/GRPO）及多智能体实战案例。从理论到代码实现，帮助开发者从 LLM 使用者转型为智能体系统构建者。
repos.summary_en: Datawhale's 'Hello-Agents' delivers a comprehensive, hands-on tutorial for building AI Native Agents from first principles, filling the gap in systematic Agent development resources. The curriculum spans core architectures, classic paradigms (ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, Reflection), low-code platforms (Coze/Dify), mainstream frameworks (AutoGen/LangGraph), self-developed HelloAgents framework, model training (SFT/GRPO), and production-ready projects like intelligent travel assistants. Designed to transform LLM users into proficient Agent system architects through practical implementation.

repos.description: Learn AI Engineering! Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repos.summary_zh: 《AI工程从零开始》是开源AI工程课程，含473课、20阶段、约320小时。从数学基础到多智能体系统与生产，覆盖Python等多语言。核心是每算法从原始数学手工构建，再用框架对比，每课产出提示、技能、代理或MCP服务器等可复用产物。填补工具使用与专业准备差距，帮助深入掌握AI internals，免费MIT许可，配网站与技能集成，适合开发者实战学习与构建系统。
repos.summary_en: AI Engineering from Scratch is a comprehensive open-source curriculum with 473 lessons across 20 phases (~320 hours). It spans math foundations to deep learning, transformers, LLMs built from scratch, agent engineering, multi-agent swarms, production, and ethics. Learners implement algorithms from raw math in Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia before frameworks. Every lesson ships reusable artifacts: prompts, skills, agents, MCP servers. Emphasizes deep understanding over API calls. Free MIT license with website and agent skills for personalized paths.

repos.description: 《动手学大模型Dive into LLMs》系列编程实践教程
repos.summary_zh: 本教程源自上海交大课程，提供大模型全栈实践指南。涵盖微调部署、提示工程、知识编辑、数学推理、模型水印、越狱攻击等前沿主题。每个章节配套Jupyter Notebook脚本与课件，支持华为昇腾国产化平台。适合高校教学、学术研究与工业实践，助力快速掌握大模型开发与安全攻防技术。
repos.summary_en: This hands-on tutorial series, derived from Shanghai Jiao Tong University courses, offers comprehensive LLMs practical guidance. Covering fine-tuning, prompting, knowledge editing, math reasoning, model watermarking, and jailbreak attacks. Each chapter includes Jupyter notebooks and slides, supporting Huawei Ascend platform. Ideal for academic teaching, research, and industrial practice in LLM development and security.

repos.description: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: GitHubDaily 是一个运营近十年的开源项目策展平台，累计分享超10000个高质量开源项目。通过GitHub仓库、公众号、微博等多渠道，系统化推荐技术教程、开发者工具与行业资讯，核心价值在于从海量项目中筛选高价值内容，并按AI工具、开发工具等维度结构化整理，助力开发者拓展技术视野与提升编程能力。
repos.summary_en: GitHubDaily is a decade-old open source curation platform that has shared over 10,000 high-quality projects. Through multiple channels including GitHub, WeChat, and Twitter, it systematically recommends technical tutorials, developer tools, and industry insights. Its core value lies in filtering high-value content from massive repositories and organizing it into structured categories like AI tools and development utilities, helping developers expand technical horizons and enhance programming skills.

repos.description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具将技术书籍PDF等文档转化为Claude Code技能。通过生成SKILL.md、章节文件、术语表、模式和速查表，实现无幻觉的精准引用与学习。按需加载章节优化资源。应用场景包括技术学习、工作参考和知识管理。技术亮点是多格式支持和结构化知识集成到AI工作流。
repos.summary_en: book-to-skill transforms technical books and documents such as PDFs and EPUBs into structured Claude Code skills. It creates a SKILL.md with core mental models and chapter index, plus on-demand chapter files, glossary, patterns, and cheatsheet. This setup allows accurate, hallucination-free referencing and studying directly in Claude workflows. Ideal for technical professionals who want to retain and apply book knowledge on the job without searching PDFs or relying on potentially inaccurate AI responses. Key advantages include support for various formats, efficient token management via lazy loading, and seamless integration as a custom skill.

repos.description: A Programmer’s Guide to Longevity | Helping everyone live a longer, healthier, happier life. Available in 8 languages.
repos.summary_zh: 本指南专为程序员设计，基于全因死亡率（ACM）学术证据，提供量化延寿策略。核心通过优化饮食（如蔬果、坚果摄入降低27% ACM）、运动（挥拍运动降47% ACM）及生活习惯（7小时睡眠），目标降低66.67% ACM并增加20年预期寿命。亮点在于结构化输入-输出框架及争议数据处理，直击久坐职业健康痛点。
repos.summary_en: Tailored for programmers, this guide leverages all-cause mortality (ACM) research to deliver quantified longevity strategies. Key actions include dietary optimization (e.g., fruits/nuts reducing ACM by 27%), racket sports (47% ACM reduction), and sleep management (7-hour optimum), targeting 66.67% ACM decrease and ~20-year lifespan gain. Unique for its input-output framework and evidence-based controversy analysis, addressing sedentary occupational health risks.

repos.description: 📚 从零开始构建大模型
repos.summary_zh: Datawhale推出的Happy-LLM是系统性大语言模型学习教程，从NLP基础到Transformer架构层层深入，手把手教你实现LLaMA2模型并完成预训练、微调全流程。项目结合理论与实践，覆盖RAG、Agent等前沿应用，为零基础学习者提供从原理理解到动手实战的完整路径，真正掌握大模型开发核心技能。
repos.summary_en: Happy-LLM by Datawhale is a comprehensive tutorial that demystifies large language models from the ground up. Starting with NLP fundamentals and Transformer architecture, it provides hands-on guidance to implement LLaMA2 and execute the complete training workflow—from pre-training to fine-tuning with LoRA/QLoRA. The project bridges theory and practice, covering cutting-edge applications including RAG and Agent development, equipping learners with essential skills to build and deploy LLMs independently.

repos.description: An evolving how-to guide for securing a Linux server.
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库提供全面的 Linux 服务器安全加固实践指南，涵盖 SSH 密钥与 2FA 认证、UFW 防火墙配置、Fail2Ban/CrowdSec 入侵防御、AIDE 文件完整性监控等核心模块。通过 Ansible Playbooks 实现自动化部署，结合纵深防御理念，为系统管理员和 DevOps 提供从基础加固到持续审计的一站式安全解决方案。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a comprehensive, continuously updated guide for Linux server security hardening with actionable implementations. It systematically covers SSH hardening with key-based authentication and two-factor authentication, network security via UFW firewall and PSAD intrusion detection, application-layer protection using Fail2Ban and CrowdSec, and continuous monitoring through AIDE file integrity checks, Lynis auditing, and OSSEC HIDS. The guide emphasizes defense-in-depth strategies and provides production-ready Ansible Playbooks for automated deployment, making it an essential resource for system administrators, DevOps engineers, and security professionals seeking to implement robust server security from fundamentals to advanced threat detection.

repos.description: A modern ebook manager and reader with sync and backup capacities for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and Web
repos.summary_zh: Koodo Reader 是一款开源的跨平台电子书阅读管理工具，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 及 Web 全平台。核心亮点包括：支持 EPUB、PDF、MOBI 等 15+ 格式，集成 OneDrive、Google Drive 等 10+ 云存储实现数据同步，内置 AI 词典翻译与文本朗读功能，提供丰富的阅读自定义选项，是个人数字阅读管理的理想解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Koodo Reader is an open-source, cross-platform ebook management and reading application supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and Web. Key features include: compatibility with 15+ formats including EPUB, PDF, and MOBI; seamless synchronization via 10+ cloud services like OneDrive and Google Drive; integrated AI-powered dictionary, translation and text-to-speech; extensive customization for fonts, themes and layouts. It provides a comprehensive solution for personal digital reading management across all devices.

repos.description: The official source code repository for the calibre ebook manager
repos.summary_zh: calibre 是一款功能全面的电子书管理工具，支持主流格式查看、转换、编辑与编目。其核心优势在于强大的格式转换引擎、跨平台兼容性（Linux/Windows/macOS）、设备同步能力，以及自动抓取元数据和将新闻转换为电子书的功能，是构建个人数字图书馆的理想解决方案。
repos.summary_en: calibre is a comprehensive e-book management suite offering viewing, conversion, editing, and cataloging across major formats. Key strengths include a powerful conversion engine, cross-platform support (Linux/Windows/macOS), device synchronization, automated metadata fetching, and news-to-ebook conversion capabilities, making it ideal for personal digital library management.

repos.summary_zh: Vibe Coding指南是AI结对编程的实战手册，通过自然语言交互让开发者专注创意而非实现细节。项目提供多语言支持的完整工作流，涵盖从构思到部署的全链路最佳实践，助力开发者构建AI驱动的高效编程范式。
repos.summary_en: Vibe Coding Guide is a practical handbook for AI pair programming, enabling developers to focus on creativity through natural language interaction. It offers a complete workflow with multilingual support, covering end-to-end best practices from ideation to deployment for building AI-driven development paradigms.

repos.description: Chinese copywriting guidelines for better written communication／中文文案排版指北
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供全面的中文文案排版规范，系统性地统一中英文、数字间的空格规则，规范标点符号使用、全半角字符标准，以及专有名词正确大小写。旨在降低团队协作沟通成本，提升内容质量和网站专业气质。包含丰富实用示例和争议性案例讨论，并集成pangu.js等自动化工具实现规则检查。适用于网站、文档、UI界面等所有中文内容创作场景，是开发者、设计师和内容创作者的标准化必备参考指南。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides comprehensive Chinese copywriting and typesetting guidelines, standardizing spacing between Chinese/English characters and numbers, proper punctuation usage, and correct capitalization. It aims to reduce team communication costs and enhance content quality. Includes practical examples, controversial edge cases, and integrates automation tools like pangu.js for rule enforcement. Essential for developers, designers, and content creators working with Chinese language content across websites, documentation, and UI interfaces.

repos.description: Pocket Flow: Codebase to Tutorial
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Pocket Flow 框架的 AI 代码库分析项目，能自动爬取 GitHub 仓库并构建知识库，通过识别核心抽象和交互关系，将复杂代码转化为适合新手的可视化教程。项目已生成 AutoGen、FastAPI、LangGraph 等热门框架的教程，并在 Hacker News 获得 900+ 赞。提供在线服务 code2tutorial.com，用户只需粘贴 GitHub 链接即可生成教程，极大降低了代码库的学习门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project uses the Pocket Flow LLM framework to automatically crawl GitHub repositories and build knowledge bases. It analyzes entire codebases to identify core abstractions and interactions, transforming complex code into beginner-friendly tutorials with visualizations. The system has generated tutorials for popular frameworks like AutoGen, FastAPI, and LangGraph, reaching Hacker News front page with 900+ upvotes. An online service at code2tutorial.com is now available, allowing users to simply paste a GitHub link to generate tutorials without installation.

repos.description: PDF craft can convert PDF files into various other formats. This project will focus on processing PDF files of scanned books.
repos.summary_zh: PDF Craft 是基于 DeepSeek OCR 的本地 PDF 转换工具，专注于扫描书籍的数字化处理。支持 GPU 加速，可将 PDF 转换为 Markdown 或 EPUB 格式，自动识别文档结构、提取正文、过滤页眉页脚，并正确处理表格、公式和脚注。v1.0.0 后完全本地化，无需网络请求，性能显著提升。
repos.summary_en: PDF Craft is a high-performance local PDF conversion tool built on DeepSeek OCR technology, specifically designed for digitizing scanned books and documents. The tool leverages GPU acceleration to efficiently convert PDF files into structured Markdown or EPUB formats while preserving document integrity. Key features include automatic document structure recognition, intelligent extraction of main text content, removal of interfering elements like headers and footers, and proper handling of complex elements such as tables, mathematical formulas, and footnotes. Starting from version 1.0.0, PDF Craft operates entirely offline without network dependencies, eliminating previous limitations of LLM-based text correction while delivering substantially improved conversion speed and reliability for academic and technical documents.

repos.description: Easy and blazing-fast book searcher, create and search your private library.
repos.summary_zh: 极速图书搜索引擎，支持创建私有书库。一分钟索引超1000万图书元数据，检索响应仅30微秒。提供跨平台桌面应用、命令行工具及Web API，支持Docker、Vercel/Netlify部署，可按字段精准搜索。
repos.summary_en: Ultra-fast book search engine for private libraries. Indexes 10M+ books/min, searches in 30µs. Cross-platform desktop, CLI, Web API. Docker/Vercel support.

repos.description: 《大语言模型》作者：赵鑫，李军毅，周昆，唐天一，文继荣
repos.summary_zh: 本书系统阐述大语言模型技术体系，涵盖预训练、微调、对齐及提示工程等核心内容。基于作者团队前沿研究与工业实践，提供完整技术框架与路线图，配套教学课件。适合具深度学习基础的读者入门大模型技术，可作为高校课程与行业研发权威参考。
repos.summary_en: This book systematically presents the comprehensive technical framework of Large Language Models, covering fundamental aspects including pre-training, fine-tuning, alignment, and prompt engineering. Based on the authors' pioneering research and practical industrial experience in developing models like Wenlan and Yulan, it offers a structured learning roadmap with supplementary lecture slides. Aimed at readers with foundational deep learning knowledge, this authoritative volume serves as an essential reference for both academic courses and industrial R&D in LLM technology, bridging theoretical concepts with real-world implementation.

repos.description: Build a modern LLM from scratch. Every line commented. Explained like we are five.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个从零构建现代大语言模型的教学项目，采用LLaMA 3架构风格，包含12章7500+行完全注释的代码。核心亮点是"像教五岁小孩一样解释复杂概念"，通过儿童级类比和逐行注释深入讲解RoPE位置编码、注意力机制、RMSNorm、SwiGLU等核心技术。提供18个独立主题解释器和完整句子前向传播演练，仅需Python基础即可理解LLM底层原理，适合想真正掌握Transformer架构的开发者。
repos.summary_en: An interactive textbook for building a modern LLM from scratch using LLaMA 3-style architecture. Features 12 chapters with 7,500+ fully commented lines, 18 standalone topic explainers, and child-friendly analogies for complex concepts like RoPE, attention, and SwiGLU. Requires only basic Python knowledge, no ML prerequisites. Includes narrative walkthroughs tracing sentences through the entire model, making it ideal for engineers who want deep understanding of Transformer internals rather than just API usage.

repos.description: Help AI coding agents write modern Go
repos.summary_zh: JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines 为 AI 编码代理提供 Go 现代编程指南。从 go.mod 自动检测项目 Go 版本，使用 1.0-1.27 最新特性（slices.Contains、cmp.Or、errors.AsType[T] 等）。规避训练数据滞后和频率偏见，生成简洁高效代码，减少后续维护。涵盖 modernize 分析器全部目标功能，适用于 Junie、Claude Code、Cursor 等代理。
repos.summary_en: JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines provides Go modern coding guidelines for AI coding agents. Automatically detects project Go version from go.mod and uses latest features from 1.0 to 1.27 (e.g., slices.Contains, cmp.Or, errors.AsType[T]). Avoids training data lag and frequency bias, generating clean and efficient code with minimal maintenance. Covers all targets of the modernize analyzer; integrates with Junie, Claude Code, Cursor and others.

repos.summary_zh: dg-ai-notes 是冬瓜的 AI 学习笔记仓库，专注 Pi-Agent SDK 深度教程。Pi-Agent 作为生产级 AI Agent 运行时底座，提供 Agent Loop、工具系统、消息系统、事件驱动及会话管理等核心能力。教程分 10 章系统拆解源码设计，每章涵盖概念、实现与设计取舍，提供 TypeScript 和 Python 双版本对照，支持在线 Web 阅读、Markdown 下载、PDF 及 Notebook 实验。帮助开发者理解生产级 Agent 架构，搭建可靠 AI 应用。
repos.summary_en: dg-ai-notes is Winter Melon's AI learning notes repo focused on an in-depth tutorial for the Pi-Agent SDK. Pi-Agent is a production-grade runtime base for AI Agents, featuring Agent Loop, tool system, messaging, event-driven architecture, and session management. The 10-chapter tutorial dissects source code design with both TypeScript and Python versions, offering web reading, Markdown/PDF downloads, and an interactive notebook. It helps developers understand and build reliable AI Agent systems.

repos.description: :earth_americas: machine learning tutorials (mainly in Python3)
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库是系统性的机器学习教程集合，以Jupyter Notebook形式提供。内容涵盖深度学习、强化学习、时间序列等多个领域，核心特色在于平衡数学原理与工程实践：既包含NumPy/SciPy等科学计算栈的从零实现，也演示TensorFlow、PyTorch、scikit-learn等主流框架的工业级应用。适合希望深入理解算法底层并掌握实际部署技能的学习者。
repos.summary_en: This repository is a comprehensive collection of machine learning tutorials in Jupyter Notebook format. It covers diverse topics including deep learning, reinforcement learning, time series analysis, and recommendation systems. The key feature is balancing mathematical theory with hands-on implementation—both from scratch using Python's scientific stack (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, PySpark) and with popular frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and Hugging Face. It serves as an educational resource for learners seeking deep algorithmic understanding alongside practical engineering skills in model deployment and A/B testing.

repos.description: 将被语言阻隔的作品，带到读者的语言中。Bringing literature into your language.
repos.summary_zh: 文译（wenyi）是专注于多语言小说翻译成中文的AI工具，支持EPUB/FB2/TXT输入并保留原排版、图片、目录和链接。采用多档LLM（strong/cheap/fast）驱动的流水线，包括全书预扫、术语库管理、滚动上下文、润色、章末审校和一致性QA，确保长文本翻译准确连贯。提供CLI断点续传功能，适合个人或小团队实现外国文学的自动化本地化。
repos.summary_en: Wenyi is an AI-powered tool for translating multilingual novels from EPUB, FB2 or TXT into Chinese while preserving original formatting, images, TOC and links. It uses a multi-tier LLM pipeline (strong/cheap/fast) with book pre-scan, glossary management, rolling context, polishing, chapter review and consistency QA for accurate long-form translations. Features CLI with resumable processing, ideal for efficient localization of foreign literature.

repos.description: This guide is designed for OpenClaw itself (Agent-facing), not as a traditional human-only hardening checklist.
repos.summary_zh: 本指南专为高权限自主AI Agent（OpenClaw）设计，颠覆传统人工加固清单模式。针对终端/root级权限场景，提出Agentic零信任架构，通过事前行为黑名单与供应链审计、事中权限收缩与跨技能检查、事后13项核心指标nightly审计的三层防御矩阵，有效缓解提示注入、供应链投毒等LLM特有风险。支持Agent自主理解并部署安全策略，大幅降低人工配置成本。
repos.summary_en: This guide is purpose-built for high-privilege autonomous AI agents like OpenClaw, shifting from traditional host-based defense to Agentic Zero-Trust Architecture. It addresses LLM-specific threats including prompt injection and supply chain poisoning through a 3-Tier Defense Matrix: pre-action blacklists and skill audits, in-action permission narrowing, and post-action nightly audits of 13 core metrics. Designed to be interpreted and executed directly by agents, it enables autonomous security deployment and validation, dramatically reducing manual configuration overhead while maintaining human oversight for high-risk operations.

repos.description: 🐎 Ryan Lopopolo’s anthology, field guide, and agent context bundle for harness engineering
repos.summary_zh: “Harness Engineering”是Ryan Lopopolo的文集、领域指南与代理上下文包，专注通过环境塑造提升AI编码代理输出。将模型与代理视为黑箱，核心优化上下文、工具及组织非功能需求（可靠性、安全等）的集成。强调使仓库教导代理、累积一致性反馈循环与最后一英里部署，帮助代理获取私有流程数据。提供AGENTS.md、论文索引和剧本，适用于组织级AI驱动开发与维护，实现判断累积与可靠迭代。
repos.summary_en: Harness Engineering is Ryan Lopopolo’s anthology, field guide, and agent context bundle for improving AI coding agent output by engineering the surrounding environment. Treating models and agents as black boxes, it focuses on curating context, tools, and organizational nonfunctional requirements like reliability and security. Key ideas include making repositories teach agents, achieving cumulative coherence via iterative feedback, and enabling last-mile deployment. The repo provides AGENTS.md, thesis index, and playbooks to integrate private process data, boosting reliable, aligned agent performance in real-world systems.

repos.description: AI Code Guide is a roadmap to start coding with AI
repos.summary_zh: AI编程指南：系统梳理AI辅助代码生成工具链与实践，整合vibe coding、MCP/A2A协议等前沿知识。面向开发者和零基础者，提供一站式学习路径与批判性视角。
repos.summary_en: AI Coding Guide: Roadmap covering vibe coding, MCP protocols, AI tools for developers and beginners.

repos.description: Translate full-length books and documents with Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Poe or OpenRouter. Preserves formatting. Resumes where you left off. No file size limits.
repos.summary_zh: 该桌面应用利用Ollama、OpenAI、Gemini等LLM翻译书籍、字幕和文档，支持EPUB、SRT、DOCX、TXT格式。智能分块处理任意长度文件，严格保留格式、样式与结构，支持断点续传。提供本地隐私部署与云端API选项，跨平台易用，适合长篇内容多语言处理与本地化场景。
repos.summary_en: TranslateBooksWithLLMs is a cross-platform desktop app that leverages LLMs like local Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini and others to translate full-length books, subtitles and documents. It supports EPUB, SRT, DOCX and TXT formats with perfect preservation of structure and styling, uses intelligent chunking for unlimited file sizes while maintaining context, and features automatic checkpoints for resuming translations. Offers both offline local processing and cloud APIs via a simple local web interface.

repos.description: Agent skill for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw that translates entire books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel subagents.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是基于Claude Code的电子书翻译工具，采用并行子代理架构实现整本书的高效翻译。支持PDF/DOCX/EPUB输入，自动分块、并行翻译、验证合并，输出多格式文档。核心技术包括8并发子代理、SHA-256清单验证和断点续传，有效解决长文本上下文溢出问题。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Claude Code-based ebook translation tool that uses parallel subagents for efficient whole-book translation. It supports PDF/DOCX/EPUB input, automatically chunking, parallel translating, validating, and merging into multiple formats. Key features include 8 concurrent subagents, SHA-256 manifest validation, and resumable runs to solve long-text context overflow.

repos.description: 零知识证明入门教程。Comprehensive Zero-Knowledge Proofs Tutorial. #zk #WIP
repos.summary_zh: WTF-zk 为零知识证明入门教程，面向高中数学基础学习者。项目以 Python 实现核心算法，系统涵盖数论、抽象代数、椭圆曲线等数学基础，并逐步深入 ZK 证明理论。通过 Jupyter Notebook 交互式教学，结合经典密码学方案复现，为零知识证明领域提供低门槛、理论与实践结合的学习路径。
repos.summary_en: WTF-zk is a comprehensive Zero-Knowledge Proofs tutorial designed for learners with only high school mathematics background. The project uses Python to implement core cryptographic algorithms, systematically covering essential mathematical foundations including number theory, abstract algebra, ring fields, and elliptic curves. Through interactive Jupyter Notebook demonstrations and step-by-step reproduction of classic schemes like RSA and Diffie-Hellman, it creates an accessible, theory-practice integrated learning pathway into the ZK proofs domain.

repos.description: ML algorithms implemented and derived from first-principles in Jupyter Notebooks and NumPy
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过 Jupyter Book 和 Marimo 构建交互式机器学习可视化平台，核心价值在于从第一性原理出发，使用 NumPy 纯 Python 实现神经网络、逻辑回归、PCA 等核心算法并配套数学推导。动态可视化训练过程，直观展示权重变化对损失函数的影响，是理解算法内部机制的顶级教学工具。
repos.summary_en: This project builds an interactive ML visualization platform using Jupyter Book and Marimo. It implements core algorithms—neural networks, logistic regression, PCA, etc.—from first principles with NumPy, accompanied by mathematical derivations. Dynamic visualizations show training progression and weight-loss relationships, serving as a premier educational tool for understanding algorithmic internals.

repos.description: A step-by-step guide to build your own AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个18步渐进式教程，从零构建生产级AI智能体。涵盖单智能体能力（工具、记忆、网络访问）、事件驱动架构、多智能体协作及生产化特性。每个步骤提供可运行代码与详细设计决策，使用LiteLLM支持多模型提供商，适合学习与实践。
repos.summary_en: An 18-step progressive tutorial for building production-ready AI agents from scratch. Covers single-agent capabilities (tools, memory, web access), event-driven architecture, multi-agent collaboration, and production features. Each step includes runnable code and design decisions, using LiteLLM for multi-provider support, ideal for learning and practice.

repos.description: 👏极客时间 pdf & markdown 文档
repos.summary_zh: 该项目聚合极客时间优质课程文档，提供 Markdown 与 PDF 双格式离线资源。核心价值在于构建可全文检索的技术知识库，支持 Docker 一键部署解决图片加载问题，并适配 PC 与移动端浏览器。基于 MkDocs-Material 主题实现优雅阅读体验，是技术人离线学习与知识管理的实用方案。
repos.summary_en: This project aggregates GeekTime's premium course documentation, offering offline Markdown and PDF resources. Its core value lies in building a full-text searchable technical knowledge base, featuring Docker deployment for image loading fixes, and responsive design for PC/mobile browsers. Powered by MkDocs-Material, it provides an elegant reading experience for developers' offline learning and knowledge management.

repos.description: 600 行 TypeScript 写成的超级迷你版 pi，让你轻松从 0 写出属于你的 pi-agent
repos.summary_zh: 本项目用约600行TypeScript从零实现迷你版pi编码Agent（nano-pi），支持读文件、改代码、执行命令。配套交互网站，阅读时右侧同步补全源码，并提供Trace断点调试，直观展示Agent数据流与核心循环。剥离工程细节，聚焦直觉化组件设计，适合快速掌握AI智能体原理与实现。
repos.summary_en: A 600-line TypeScript mini coding agent (nano-pi) built from scratch, inspired by pi. Supports file reading, code editing and command execution via OpenAI-compatible APIs. Interactive site progressively reveals source code while reading, with Trace debugging for execution flow. Strips engineering complexity to focus on core agent ideas, ideal for learning AI agent architecture.

repos.description: CSAPP 中文文档与学习资料：《深入理解计算机系统》第三版全章节 Markdown，含练习题答案、八大实验中文翻译及官方自学实验包，方便在线阅读与离线学习。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供《深入理解计算机系统》（CSAPP第三版）完整中文Markdown资料，涵盖全部12章正文、练习题与原书答案、附录及八大实验的中文说明与官方自学包。支持在线阅读网站（章节导航、全文搜索、深色模式）与本地离线使用，方便系统学习计算机底层原理、做题与实验实践。
repos.summary_en: Complete Chinese Markdown resources for CSAPP 3rd Edition, including all 12 chapters, practice problem answers, appendices, and Chinese translations of the eight official labs with self-study packages. Features an online reading site with navigation, full-text search and dark mode, plus offline Markdown for systematic study of computer systems, problem-solving and hands-on labs.

repos.description: A comprehensive book on neural networks and large language models in NLP
repos.summary_zh: NiuTrans/NLPBook仓库发布《Natural Language Processing: Neural Networks and Large Language Models》一书，由童晓、朱靖波撰写。系统覆盖机器学习与神经网络基础、词向量、RNN/CNN、Seq2Seq、Transformer，以及大模型的预训练、生成、提示工程、对齐与推理等前沿内容。提供各章节及完整免费PDF下载，基于arXiv论文扩展，适合NLP研究者、学生和开发者学习使用，并有中、日、法等多语言翻译版本。
repos.summary_en: The NiuTrans/NLPBook repository presents the book 'Natural Language Processing: Neural Networks and Large Language Models' by Tong Xiao and Jingbo Zhu. It comprehensively covers ML and neural network foundations, word vectors, RNN/CNN, Seq2Seq, Transformers, plus LLM topics including pre-training, generative models, prompting, alignment, and inference. Free PDF chapters and full book are available, expanded from arXiv papers. Ideal educational resource for NLP researchers, students, and practitioners, with translations into multiple languages.

repos.description: Official repository of my book "A Hands-On Guide to Fine-Tuning LLMs with PyTorch and Hugging Face"
repos.summary_zh: 这是一本使用PyTorch和Hugging Face微调大语言模型的实战指南。系统讲解量化、LoRA低秩适配、数据集格式化等稳定核心技术，涵盖模型加载、SFTTrainer微调到本地部署全流程。提供可直接运行的Google Colab notebooks，适合具备Transformer基础的中级开发者深入理解配置原理与底层实现。
repos.summary_en: A hands-on guide repository for fine-tuning Large Language Models with PyTorch and Hugging Face. Covers quantization, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and dataset formatting templates through practical Colab notebooks. Includes complete workflow from loading quantized models to supervised fine-tuning with SFTTrainer and local deployment. Targets intermediate practitioners, explaining configuration principles and stable concepts essential for adapting to evolving LLM technologies.

repos.description: Learn everything about world model
repos.summary_zh: 本GitHub仓库是Datawhale的《Learn World Models》开源课程，系统介绍世界模型从直觉到构建的全流程。包括历史演进、VAE编码、RSSM动态、架构对比、规划算法及评估指标等内容，并提供VAE训练、RSSM构建、Dreamer智能体等实践项目。强调动手实现模拟、规划与评估系统，适合AI智能体开发者和强化学习研究者学习。
repos.summary_en: This Datawhale GitHub repository presents the 'Learn World Models' course, offering a structured path from intuition to implementation of world models in AI. It covers historical evolution, VAE encoding, RSSM dynamics, architecture patterns, planning algorithms, and evaluation metrics. Five lectures and five projects enable building VAE encoders, RSSM models, Dreamer agents, and evaluation dashboards. The highlight is combining theory with hands-on practice for simulation, planning, and assessment systems, ideal for AI agent developers and reinforcement learning researchers.

repos.description: distill any book down to its spine
repos.summary_zh: SpineDigest 是专为 AI 智能体设计的知识库 CLI 工具，支持将 EPUB、Markdown 和纯文本导入为可移植 .wikg 知识档案，利用大模型提取知识图谱、摘要与实体关系，并提供 URI 驱动的搜索、结构浏览和阅读模式。它将长文档转化为可维护、可导航的知识基地，而非一次性摘要输出，核心价值在于为 AI 代理提供源可追溯的结构化知识访问与上下文打包能力。
repos.summary_en: SpineDigest is a Node.js CLI optimized for AI agents that converts EPUB, Markdown, and text into portable .wikg knowledge archives. It leverages LLMs to extract knowledge graphs, summaries, and entities, exposing the archive via URI-based search, hierarchical structure, and reading modes. The primary artifact is the reusable .wikg file, enabling navigable, source-backed knowledge bases for long documents rather than one-shot summaries, with export options for AI context packing and reuse.

repos.description: 微信读书全本导出工具 — Playwright + Canvas Hook 提取完整书籍内容为 Markdown
repos.summary_zh: 微信读书全本导出工具，通过Playwright自动化浏览器并Hook Canvas fillText方法，拦截渲染文本，结合y坐标拆分双页内容，按坐标重建段落并清理格式，导出为Markdown。适用于个人学习研究，需有效微信读书账号权限。技术亮点包括持久化登录、双页处理及文本重建，支持章节独立输出与元数据保存，解决网页版无法直接复制的问题。
repos.summary_en: weread-exporter exports complete WeRead books to Markdown by using Playwright to automate Chromium and hooking CanvasRenderingContext2D.fillText to capture canvas-rendered text. It splits double-page renders via y-coordinate detection, reconstructs paragraphs from (x,y) coordinates, and cleans formatting. Designed for personal study with valid account access, it features persistent QR login, per-chapter Markdown files, metadata JSON, and optional raw data. Addresses web version copy restrictions with ~20-30s per chapter speed.

repos.description: VerbaAurea： 一个文档预处理工具，专注于为知识库构建提供高质量的文本数据。
repos.summary_zh: VerbaAurea 是专注于知识库构建的智能文档预处理工具，通过多维度评分系统实现语义完整的文档分割。支持DOCX/PDF批量处理，保留原始格式，提供Web界面与命令行两种模式。核心亮点包括句子边界检测、自适应长度控制与中英文差异化处理策略，为RAG和LLM微调提供高质量训练数据。
repos.summary_en: VerbaAurea is an intelligent document preprocessing tool specialized for knowledge base construction, achieving semantic-preserving segmentation through a multi-dimensional scoring system. It supports batch processing of DOCX/PDF formats with original formatting retention, offering both Web UI and CLI modes. Key features include sentence boundary detection, adaptive length control, and differentiated processing strategies for Chinese/English texts, delivering high-quality training data for RAG and LLM fine-tuning.
